# hot cocoa girl

> Static Astro publication site styled with Tailwind CSS, deployed on GitHub Pages at https://hotcocoagirl.github.io

## Blog

- [Learning to Rest](/blog/learning-to-rest/): An essay on rest.

## About

hot cocoa girl is a personal publication. Posts cover topics including Nutrition, Happiness, Love, Economics, Morality, God, Philosophy, Art, Beauty, Fashion, Building, and Wellness.
